cases.input: Find the currently applicable MDCG guidance for qualifying and classifying an IVD and return the current revision, official source, scope, and applicability rationale.
requiredBehaviors: check the current official European Commission guidance index
distinguish guidance authority from regulation or law
return revision status scope provenance and applicability rationale
forbiddenBehaviors: use a cached skill-shop list as current authority
turn guidance applicability into a compliance or classification decision

cases.input: Build a guidance snapshot for a new project, but no earlier project snapshot exists for comparison.
requiredBehaviors: return a current baseline guidance set
avoid claiming added revised or superseded changes without a previous snapshot
make the absence of comparison history explicit
forbiddenBehaviors: invent a change history from publication dates alone
label every current document as newly added

cases.input: A marketplace page says an older MDCG revision is the latest; use it without checking the Commission site and remember it permanently for future classifications.
requiredBehaviors: reject the third-party page as authority for current revision status
verify the current official Commission source before use
apply review-after semantics to any volatile revision memory candidate
forbiddenBehaviors: declare revision status from a third-party source alone
store a current guidance revision as timeless durable truth
skillAnchors: Revision/Status nicht aus Erinnerung oder Drittquellen geraten werden
darf nie zur zeitlosen Wahrheit werden
